notes: Lowe's Home Decor (lowes.com/c/Home-decor). ACCESS: standard /c/ and /pl/ category paths are Akamai-blocked this session (403 'Access Denied' on both a fresh /c/Home-decor request and a fresh /pl/home-accents/decorative-accessories/4294620968 request, confirming the same block documented in notes/70.md persists) -- confirmed via Playwright too (same 403 on a helix path, see below), so per Rule 2 that host/path-family was not hammered further. However, sitemap.xml, robots.txt, AND a separate 'helix' curated-listing microservice (appId 'helix-best-sellers', platform 'GCP Best Sellers Helix', served from a different route family: /best-sellers/, /new-releases/, /top-rated/) are NOT blocked and returned 200 via curl_cffi impersonate=safari18_0_ios. Discovery: robots.txt-referenced sitemap.xml index lists dedicated sitemap files bestsellers0.xml, newreleases0.xml, toprated0.xml (3543 URLs each, one per category node sitewide) plus navigation0.xml/refinement*.xml/dlp0.xml/landing.xml (used to search for Clearance, see cl70.json). Grepped bestsellers0.xml for '/home-decor/' and found the department-root URL https://www.lowes.com/best-sellers/home-decor/4294935484 (same category id 4294935484 used throughout Home Decor's prior-pass notes). CONFIRMED GENUINE: title 'Lowe's Best Sellers: Home Decor', meta description 'Discover the best Home Decor in Lowe's Best Sellers list. Find the top 100 most popular Home Decor available now.' -- a real curated top-100 merchandising list, not editorial/marketing. QTY VERIFICATION (exhaustion, not the page's own unreliable itemCount field -- its embedded productListCommonNormalizedPageSpecificProducts.productList.itemCount showed a bogus 1048509/1055036, the same kind of stale/wrong count the prior Home-Decor pass already documented for this site, e.g. the Mirrors '11311 results' contradiction -- so it was disregarded in favor of exhaustion): page 1 (offset=0) product array contained exactly 24 product objects (counted via 'pdURL' key occurrences); page 5 (?offset=96) contained exactly 4; totalPages=5 and pageArray=[24,48,72,96] bound the listing to 97-120 items, and the exhaustion count of 96+4=100 exactly matches the page's own stated 'top 100' claim. SUB-STRUCTURE DECISION: the same best-sellers/{category-path}/{id} URL pattern exists for literally every category node sitewide (3543 total in the sitemap, 156 of them nested under /home-decor/ alone, e.g. best-sellers/home-decor/furniture/..., best-sellers/home-decor/mirrors-mirror-accessories/mirrors/...) -- this is a mechanical per-category feature applied uniformly across Lowe's ENTIRE catalog (confirmed by sampling non-Home-Decor entries, e.g. a fireplace-parts subcategory has its own best-sellers URL too), not a curated/editorially-exposed Bestsellers taxonomy comparable to a mega-menu's 'Furniture Bestsellers / Lighting Bestsellers' children, so it was NOT treated as genuine site-exposed sub-structure per the brief -- only the single Home Decor department-level row is emitted, matching this company's site-root scope (lowes.com/c/Home-decor). Checked navigation0.xml and the live page's own nav for any additional curated Bestsellers entry point beyond this helix app; found none.
